answer: Fake identities enter a cost spiral, since every new key demands fresh stake and independent vouching from distinct meadow-grown peers, making mass forgery economically irrational. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted reputation slot binding: each agent must lock a non-trivial bond that decays across epochs, and reputation accrues only on the horizon of verified peer attestations. Attackers pay linearly in locked capital plus attestation risk, while honest participants amortize one bond across many tasks. In practice, Agent0132 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
